ruleDefinitions.name: File Information Gathering Command Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: This rule detects attempts to gather file information with the 'lsof' command. This could be indicative of an attacker trying to understand the open files on the system for further attacks.

sequences.query:
activity_type:"process-create"
AND platform:"Unix"
AND (
    process_name:"lsof"
    OR process_command_line:"lsof -i"
    OR process_command_line:"ls /etc"
    OR process_command_line:"ls /root"
    OR process_command_line:"ls /var/log"
)
AND NOT user:("root","ubuntu","ansible","system")
